## Description
Please describe your changes, their rationale, and how they benefit the project.

Fixes / Related Issues: # (issue number)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Refactoring (internal code cleanup / optimization)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have tested my changes in at least one modern web browser (e.g. Chrome, Firefox).
- [ ] My changes are responsive and scale correctly on standard aspect ratios (such as 16:9).
- [ ] I have verified that no hardcoded passwords, tokens, or environment variables are leaked.
- [ ] I have successfully run `npm run build` locally, and verified that the compiled `dist/index.html` operates correctly offline.
- [ ] I have updated the documentation (`README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`) if necessary.
